components.explanation: Clip 1, the mage run: features/player/player.tscn holds one clip per state (run: a discrete frame track over the 4-cell sheet, 0.4 s, step 0.1, LOOP_LINEAR); player.gd only calls play() from _set_state(); the r2 sheet with its credits and cleaning tool, the r0 sheet and its packing tool, the rejected far-leg tool, the Gemini inputs and outputs with their prompt log, and the run preview scene.

Clip 2, the wolf lunge: a cutout rig under Facing (two region_rect parts of the A2 lunge image on hip and shoulder pivots) keyed as resource text in features/wolf/wolf.tscn (lunge, 89 frames, step 1/60, LOOP_NONE); wolf.gd plays it on GROWL entry and seeks the recovery section on a growl hit; the afterimage node; the lunge preview scene.

Beyond the requirements: two PointLight2D torches with a looping continuous-track flicker clip on the process clock (nothing in gameplay reads it), 144 embers, and their placement in game/main.tscn (with the lighter world darkening); visible behind every gameplay beat.

The checks around both clips: the behaviour pin, the edges test, the clip read-backs with the published track_problems() and the step and half-frame helpers, the structure and afterimage tests, the growl-cancel and two-clocks probes, the capture harnesses for the fixture strips, and the figure and seam-measuring tools.
